label: Cursor Performer
description: The film's protagonist hand: a cursor that travels the scene and CLICKS the thing that causes the next beat -- UI exhibits become a story someone is doing. Position its box over the whole stage at a high z_index. CONTINUITY CONTRACT: when threading the cursor across consecutive scenes, make each scene's FIRST path point equal the previous scene's LAST point (same x/y), so the hand reads as continuous through hard cuts. Use on 2-4 consecutive UI scenes max; it should always be traveling toward or clicking something meaningful.

path.label: [{at, x:'62%', y:'48%', click?:true}] -- scene-local seconds, stage-relative coords

enter.label: 'fade' to fade in at the first point (default: present from start)

exit.label: 'fade' to fade out after the last point
